summary: Frontend-only testing of the Lons-le-Saunier 3D cartography app. All 12 requested acceptance criteria pass. Header + red 'Données OSM · Direct' badge render, MapLibre canvas fills main area (1140x836), CARTO Voyager is the default basemap with 3D extrusions, default Mobilité theme has bike_parking / cycle_lanes / bus_shelter ON and bus_lines OFF, GeoDataMine returns 144 bike parkings and 496 cycleways as expected, Commerces tab swaps to 617 shops and 95 restaurants, POI click opens the side detail panel with title, category badge, coordinates, French attribute labels and the OpenStreetMap link, close button and empty-map click both close the panel, layer toggle removes POIs from the map, basemap switcher opens and swaps style (verified with basemap-option-carto_dark) while keeping overlays, 3D buildings toggle hides/shows extrusions, Recentrer flies back to Lons-le-Saunier. Overpass-backed layers (bus_shelter, bus_lines) remain in 'Chargement OSM…' — expected per agent-to-agent context (Overpass unreachable from this environment).

issues: In dense downtown the 8px click bbox tolerance frequently hits cycleway lines/POIs, so the 'click empty area to close panel' UX only reliably works in peripheral/green areas. Works as designed but users in dense zones may struggle to dismiss the panel by clicking the map — consider also allowing outside-click or ESC to close.

critical_code_review_comments: MapView.jsx: the empty-click detection uses `queryRenderedFeatures` with an 8px bbox. In dense areas this almost always hits a cycleway or POI, making the 'click empty area to close panel' behavior hard to trigger. Consider adding ESC key or clicking outside the map to close.

osm.js: Overpass endpoints called from the browser succeed from the public URL in a normal browser, but are currently timing out via the preview environment egress (expected per test context). Consider a graceful UI hint that Overpass mirrors may be rate-limited, in addition to the current 'Chargement OSM…' spinner which can appear stuck indefinitely.

CartographyPage.jsx: `fetchLayerIfMissing` uses `layerData` inside useCallback with `[layerData]` dep — every fetched layer recreates the callback and re-runs the effect. Not a bug (guarded by `inflight`), but could be optimized with functional setState + ref check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria validated at https://citymap-lons.preview.emergentagent.com. GeoDataMine layers (bike_parking, cycle_lanes, shops, food) work with counts 144/496/617/95. Overpass layers (bus_shelter, bus_lines) intentionally show 'Chargement OSM…' from this container — do not flag. data-testids of note: tab-mobility-button, tab-commerces-button, layer-bike-parking-checkbox (hyphens, NOT underscores), basemap-selector-dropdown, basemap-option-<id>, 3d-buildings-toggle, map-reset-camera-button, map-locate-button, map-container, side-detail-panel, side-detail-panel-close. Empty-map click closes panel but only when the click point does not fall within the 8px query bbox around a POI/cycleway (test with coordinates in green/field areas, e.g. y<200 above the city or y>800 south of city).
